name: NewsData.io
summary: Worldwide news API: latest and archived articles with country, category, language, domain and sentiment filters, plus crypto and market news, sources and article counts.

api_key.description: a NewsData.io API key (newsdata.io dashboard). Sent in the X-ACCESS-KEY header; an apikey query parameter also works.

notes: Credits per call: latest, crypto, market and sources 1; archive 5; count endpoints 50. Cost does not depend on size; 4xx/5xx answers are free.
Free plan: 200 credits a day, 10 articles per request, 30 requests per 15 minutes, articles delayed 12 hours, last 48 hours only, no archive. Paid plans: 1800 credits per 15 minutes.
Paging is a cursor: send the response's nextPage back as page with the same other parameters; stop when it is null.
Multi-value filters are comma-separated; include and exclude versions of one filter cannot be combined.

endpoints.name: Search latest news
endpoints.summary: Articles from the past 48 hours, newest first by default.

q.description: Keywords in title, content, URL and metadata; AND/OR/NOT and quotes supported. Max 512 characters. Not with qInTitle or qInMeta.

qInTitle.description: Keywords in the title only (max 512). Not with q or qInMeta.

qInMeta.description: Keywords in title, URL and meta tags (max 512). Not with q or qInTitle.

country.description: Comma-separated country codes (5 on Free/Basic, 10 on higher plans). Not with excludecountry.

category.description: Comma-separated category codes, e.g. business,technology (5 on Free/Basic). Not with excludecategory.

language.description: Comma-separated language codes (5 on Free/Basic). Not with excludelanguage.

domainurl.description: Comma-separated domains, e.g. nytimes.com,bbc.com (5 on Free/Basic).

prioritydomain.description: Only top (top 10%), medium (30%) or low (50%) ranked sources.

full_content.description: 1 only articles with full_content, 0 only without.

size.description: Articles per page: 1 to 10 on Free, 1 to 50 on paid plans.

page.description: Next page: the nextPage value from the previous answer (a page number with relevancy, source or fetched_at sort).

sort.description: Default pubdatedesc. relevancy needs a q parameter; relevancy, source and fetched_at reach the first 10,000 results only.

timeframe.description: Last N hours (1-48) or minutes (e.g. 15m, up to 2880m).

datatype.description: Comma-separated: news, blog, multimedia, forum, pressrelease, review, research, opinion, analysis, podcast.
